course.title: Chemistry (BSc) | University of Warwick
quotes: Department Department of Chemistry Duration 3 years full-time
A level typical offer AAB to include Chemistry and one of the following: Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Physics, Biology, Geology, Statistics, Electronics or Computer Science.

International Baccalaureate (IB) typical offer 34 to include 6 in Higher Level Chemistry and 5 in a second science subject at Higher Level (either Biology, Physics, Mathematics 'Analysis and Approaches', Mathematics 'Applications and Interpretation', or Computer Science).
Warwick does not typically interview applicants.
Tuition fee £10,050 For the 2027-28 academic year, the UK government announced in March 2026 that the tuition fee cap for UK undergraduate students for the 2027-28 academic year would be £10,050.
